name: hmi_import_json
description: Upsert a versioned Unified HMI JSON directory under an Openness transaction, verify it, compile, and never save the project. Provide exactly one of input_directory or transfer_id.

dry_run.description: Validate the files and target without making changes (default: false).

input_directory.description: Server-local directory containing manifest.json and referenced files. Use this or transfer_id, not both.

transfer_id.description: Staged import ID returned by hmi_begin_import. Use this or input_directory, not both.

prune_items.description: Delete screen items absent from imported screen files (default: false).

target_name.description: Target HMI software/device selector (optional when only one target exists).

verify_hashes.description: Verify exported file hashes (default: true). Set false only when intentionally editing exported JSON without refreshing manifest hashes.
